name: MISC Berhad
overview: 2026年，MISC Berhad 联合其他联合要约方提出全面收购 Yinson Holdings Berhad 的股权，涉及集团在 offshore 领域的扩张。此外，公司续租了位于 Menara Dayabumi 的办公空间，并派发了多次免税股息。
overview_en: In 2026, MISC Berhad, together with other joint offerors, proposed a conditional voluntary general offer to acquire the entire equity interest in Yinson Holdings Berhad, involving expansion in the offshore segment. Additionally, the company renewed its office space lease at Menara Dayabumi and declared several tax-exempt dividends.

segments.name: 离岸业务
segments.note: 今年集团联合其他联合要约方提出全面收购 Yinson Holdings Berhad，以扩大离岸业务版图。
segments.note_en: This year, the group, together with other joint offerors, proposed a conditional voluntary general offer to acquire the entire equity interest in Yinson Holdings Berhad, aiming to expand its offshore…

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 联合要约方就收购 Yinson Holdings Berhad 的提议向 YHB 发出新闻通知，澄清相关事宜。
actions.text_en: The joint offerors issued a press notice to YHB to clarify matters relating to the proposed acquisition of Yinson Holdings Berhad.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 集团层面续租了位于 Menara Dayabumi 的办公空间，并派发了多次免税股息。
segments.note_en: At the group level, the company renewed its office space lease at Menara Dayabumi and declared several tax-exempt dividends.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RECURRENT RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: MISC 与 PETRONAS 签订长期租赁协议，续租位于 Menara Dayabumi 的办公空间，租期3年，并可自动续约4次，每次3年。
actions.text_en: MISC entered into a long-term tenancy agreement with PETRONAS to renew the rental of office space at Menara Dayabumi for a 3-year term, with automatic renewal of four consecutive terms of three years each.

model_changes.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
model_changes.text: 集团通过联合要约方式拟收购 Yinson Holdings Berhad 全部股权，若完成将扩大离岸业务板块。
model_changes.text_en: The group, through a joint offer, proposed to acquire the entire equity interest in Yinson Holdings Berhad, which would expand the offshore business segment if completed.
